name: Ampvolts Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, Ampvolts Ltd is in the business of sales and services related to Electric vehicle chargers and charging stations[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AVL, originally engaged in software and hardware consultancy, underwent a strategic shift in FY23 following its acquisition by M/s AV AC DC Renew Pvt Ltd. The company pivoted to electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions, amending its main object clause to focus on the operation, maintenance, and management of EV chargers and charging stations, along with related business activities.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.01 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 297 to 129 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -4.04% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.84 Cr.
